work.description: The post-synodal apostolic exhortation of 25 March 1992 on the formation of priests in the circumstances of the present day. Number 29 treats celibacy as a mode of chastity and quotes the synod fathers' proposition on the Latin discipline; n. 50 treats formation for celibacy.
